description: Out-of-office reply with return-date math — Write internal, external and one-line out-of-office auto-replies. Offline: moves a weekend or US federal holiday return date to the first business day back, counts business days away, flags a missing backup contact, a missing return date in the text, and oversharing of personal reasons (uses a neutral reason instead). Params: return (YYYY-MM-DD, required), leave (YYYY-MM-DD, default today), name, backup, reason, urgent. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_out_of_office
